boundary: Scoped strictly to: the executable neuron7x_agents DopamineOperator value-net TD error, a deterministic arithmetic-closure verifier micro-task, and the policies enumerated in this module. No claim about DOPA-CLOSURE the theory; no claim beyond this exact implementation.
claim: An actual DNCA/dopamine-derived signed vRPE predicts verification benefit better than uncertainty/margin, under an admissible verifier and a true sign-flip negative control.

negative_control_result.detail: signed vRPE is NOT truth-correlated with verification benefit (RETRACTION precondition #3 unmet); routing comparison would be an invalid instrument

signed_vrpe_definition: DopamineOperator.modulate(...)['valence'] = clamp(delta, -1, 1) where delta = r + gamma*V(s_t) - V(s_{t-1}) is the temporal-difference prediction error BEFORE the Schultz asymmetric gain. Sign is preserved; the negative control negates this signed scalar (vRPE -> -vRPE), it is NOT a complement of |vRPE|.
verified_closure_definition: A Verified-Closure event = the independent deterministic verifier spent a budgeted verification action on an item AND returned a definitive VERIFIED/REFUTED outcome bound to an evidence hash under a fixed boundary (pure recomputation, network disabled). VCR = (closure events) / (items). It is distinct from policy label accuracy: VCR counts independent verifier-confirmed closures, not whether the policy's own label was right.
